חבילת הנגשה לאתר 1. תוסף נגישות בהתאמה לתקן 5568/AA התקנת תוסף נגישות של Vee באתר שלך, תסייע למשתמשים בעלי מוגבלויות שונות לעשות שימוש אפקטיבי בשירותים המוצעים בו. לאחר ההתקנה של תוסף נגישות, האתר שלך יהיה נגיש לעיוורים ומוגבלי ראיה, בעלי מוגבלות פיזית המתקשים להפעיל את ידיהם, בעלי מוגבלויות קוגניטיביות כגון דיסלקציה והפרעות קשב וריכוז, כבדי שמיעה ובעלי מוגבלויות נוספות. לכל המסלולים והחבילות 2. התאמה אישית של הצהרת נגישות משפטית הצגת הצהרת נגישות באתר היא חובה על פי חוק. לאחר הנגשת האתר לפי תקן 5568 – AA, הצוות המשפטי שלנו יפיק עבורך מסמך הצהרת נגישות הכולל בין היתר: פירוט פעולות הנגישות באתר, הסדרי נגישות פיזיים, מינוי ופרסום פרטי רכז/ת נגישות ועוד. המסמך ינוסח תוך התייחסות להנחיות והקריטריונים הרלוונטיים לעסק שלך. למידע על הצהרת נגישות 3. בדיקה ידנית של קוד האתר ע"י צוות מומחי הנגישות שלנו יש לך אתר שאופיין ועוצב בקפידה, אבל מה קורה מתחת "לפני השטח"? לבנייה נכונה ומדויקת של האתר יש חשיבות גדולה ואלמנטים שלא הוגדרו נכון עלולים לפגוע בתהליך ההנגשה. מומחי הנגישות שלנו יסרקו את האתר שלך, ימפו את התבניות שבו ויעברו על האלמנטים והטפסים המרכזיים. בסיום התהליך, יופק דו"ח ליקויי נגישות (במידה ויש) ויוצעו פתרונות פשוטים לתיקון. בדיקת נגישות לאתר כמה עולה הנגשת אתר? חבילת הנגשת אתרים מקצועית הכוללת תוסף נגישות מתקדם, בדיקת קוד ידנית והצהרת נגישות משפטית. רישיון שנתי לשירות הנגשה מלא בהתאמה לתקן הנגישות הישראלי 5568 ברמת AA. הנגשת אתר מיועד לאתרי מסחר ותדמית הגנה מפני תביעות ישירות הצהרת נגישות מותאמת עד 10,000 דפים באתר ללא הגבלת שפות שליטה בעיצוב אייקון נגישות ליווי וייעוץ מומחה נגישות בדיקה ידנית של קוד האתר 500ש"ח /לשנה המחיר אינו כולל מע"מ הוספה לסל הנגשת אתר לאתרים גדולים/מורכבים הגנה מפני תביעות ישירות הצהרת נגישות מותאמת עד 100,000 דפים באתר ללא הגבלת שפות שליטה בעיצוב אייקון נגישות ליווי וייעוץ מומחה נגישות דו"ח מומחה נגישות 800ש"ח /לשנה המחיר אינו כולל מע"מ הוספה לסל הנגשת אתר - פרימיום הגנה מפני תביעות ישירות הצהרת נגישות מותאמת ללא הגבלת דפים ללא הגבלת שפות שליטה בעיצוב אייקון נגישות מומחה נגישות אישי עד 4 דו"חות מומחה נגישות 1200ש"ח /לשנה המחיר אינו כולל מע"מ הוספה לסל למה לבחור ב-Vee להנגשת האתר תוסף נגישות AA 0 חיסכון בעלויות הנגשה % 0 ניצול התנועה באתר % 0 ראש שקט % 0 שאלות נפוצות אספנו עבורך את התשובות לשאלות הנפוצות ביותר עבור הנגשת אתרים. עלתה לך שאלה שלא מופיעה פה? אנחנו מחכים לך עם התשובה במרכז המידע שלנו וגם זמינים בשירות הלקוחות. למרכז המידע מה הוא חוק הנגישות בישראל? מה היא הצהרת נגישות ולמה צריך אותה? מי זכאי ל-60 ימי חסד להגנה מפני תביעות? אילו עסקים חייבים בנגישות אתר האינטרנט שלהם על פי חוק? הנגשת אתר- איך זה עובד? אילו תכנים מחוייבים בנגישות? כיצד אבטיח שתוסף הנגישות באתר שלי עומד בתקן? האם תוסף הנגישות משפיע על מהירות האתר? אלו סוגי אתרים חייבים בהנגשה על פי חוק? זאת החובה שלנו בעלי מוגבלויות מהווים כ-17% מכלל האוכלוסיה בישראל. אתרים רבים אינם נגישים כיום ולכן לא מאפשרים לפלח אוכלוסיה זה להנות משירותי אונליין כמו שאר האנשים. מזמינים אתכם לצטרף לאלפי אתרים שכבר מנגישים את התוכן שלהם. יחד נוכל לאפשר לעוד שירות או מוצר להיות נגיש לכל אותם אנשים שהם חלק בלתי נפרד מהחברה שלנו. הנגשת אתרים בפלטפורמות הפופולריות ביותר תהליך התקנה ידידותי ונוח לכולם המערכת שלנו מכירה אתכם מתחילים בהרשמה לשירות והזנת פרטי אתר ועסק. אוטומציה מתקדמת לאחר ניתוח הנתונים, קוד לתוסף + הצהרת נגישות מותאמים יחכו לך באיזור האישי. התקנה פשוטה יישום והתקנת הנגישות באתר עפ"י מדריך התקנה. בדיקה ידנית צוות מומחה הנגישות שלנו עובר ובודק את קוד האתר שלך, לוודא עמידה בתקן. מידע נוסף אנחנו פה לכל שאלה וייעוץ הפרטיות שלכם חשובה לנו אנו משתמשים בקבצי Cookie כדי לשפר את חוויית הגלישה, להציג תוכן מותאם אישית ולנתח את התנועה באתר. באפשרותכם לאשר את כל קבצי ה-Cookie, לדחות קבצים שאינם הכרחיים או לנהל את ההעדפות שלכם. מדיניות פרטיות נפתח בלשונית חדשה דחה הכל ניהול קבצי Cookie קבל הכל מופעל על ידי Data Lock

Toka.title: Account Executive – European Government (Based in Netherlands / Belgium) Sales | Netherlands, NL
Toka.description: Toka ALL JOBS Account Executive – European Government (Based in Netherlands / Belgium) Sales Netherlands Full-time Description Toka provides advanced cyber and intelligence solutions to government, law enforcement, and national security agencies worldwide. Our mission is to empower those who protect their nations with the tools to combat evolving digital threats and safeguard critical infrastructure. We are looking for a high-impact Account Executive based in the Netherlands, Belgium, or Spain to drive Toka's expansion across European government, intelligence, and law enforcement markets. This is a complex, multi-country role requiring someone who can operate across cultures, navigate diverse regulatory environments, and build trust in highly sensitive government ecosystems. More than a strong salesperson, we are looking for a credible operator — someone who understands how European government systems work from the inside, and knows how to turn access into meaningful business. You are not new to this world — you've worked in it, around it, or closely alongside it. You understand the complexity of European government environments — the different stakeholders, the pace, the sensitivities, and the importance of trust. You know how to operate across borders, adapt your approach, and still drive deals forward. What You'll Do Drive Toka's expansion across multiple European markets and build a regional go-to-market strategy Build trusted relationships with government and intelligence stakeholders across Europe Identify, shape, and close new opportunities across multiple territories — owning the full sales cycle from opportunity creation to contract closure Navigate complex procurement processes across different European frameworks Position Toka's solutions in mission-critical use cases Requirements Based in the Netherlands, or Belgium Native French or Spanish speaker + fluent English Experience working in or with government, intelligence, or national security organizations in Europe Strong network within relevant agencies or ecosystems Proven success in B2G / government sales and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals Ability to obtain and maintain relevant European security clearances (as required) Background combining operational + commercial experience Willingness to travel extensively across Europe Advantages Additional European languages Experience in cybersecurity or intelligence technologies Experience working with European frameworks, partners, or integrators ALL JOBS

Toka.description: Toka ALL JOBS Senior Backend Engineer R&D Tel Aviv Senior Full-time Description Role Description We are developing products and intelligence solutions in the Cyber and IoT domains. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design and implement backend services, lead architectural decisions, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and mentor junior developers. You will take ownership of complex tasks, manage project flows within your squad, and bring strong technical opinions and architectural insights. The role requires excellent multitasking skills, strong context-switching ability, and a proactive, mission-driven mindset. Develop integrations with various internal and external systems using diverse interface protocols. Maintain ownership of features from design through deployment and ongoing operation. Effective mentor, supporting growth and onboarding of junior engineers. Independent and self-sufficient, while also an excellent team collaborator. In this role, you will research proprietary technologies and analyze complex IoT and embedded devices. You will be responsible for taking your research from initial discovery to a full end-to-end solution in production. Requirements 8+ years of relevant industry experience as a low-level vulnerability researcher. Teva Pharmaceuticals.title: How We Hire
Teva Pharmaceuticals.description: Alert: Be aware of Recruitment Scams Teva will never request payment, ask you to purchase equipment, or require financial information during the recruitment process. Learn how to identify, avoid and report recruitment scams. I understand Skip To Main Content Country Photo of Teva employees in Brazil How We Hire at Teva Our Global Hiring Process Your Guide to the Teva Pharmaceuticals Recruitment Experience Hiring Process Discover our recruitment process at Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company dedicated to better health. We’ve designed this guide to provide a transparent, step-by-step view of our recruitment journey - from submitting your CV to onboarding. Explore what we look for in our talent, find advice on how to prepare for interviews, and see how we support our global workforce with flexible work models and holistic benefits. Whether you're interested in innovative R&D, AI in pharma, early career opportunities or other roles, this is your roadmap to the hiring experience at Teva. Before you apply, learn how to stand out with your application Read more Search Jobs Our Hiring Process At Teva, our medicines reach 155 million patients around the world every day. Because our work matters, how we hire matters too. Across R&D, manufacturing, commercial, and corporate functions such as digital, IT, HR, legal and finance, we bring together people with different experiences and perspectives, all united by a shared purpose: we are all in for better health. We look for people who are curious, humble, and passionate about improving health, who bring energy and optimism to challenges, and who raise the bar by supporting their teams and helping others succeed. "Our hiring experience is designed to be transparent, respectful, and human. Whether you are starting your career journey or bring years of experience, we aim to provide clear information, consistent expectations, and the opportunity to show your strengths and talents throughout the process." Idit Booch, Head of Talent Acquisition at Teva Below, you will find an overview of our hiring process, along with practical tips for each stage. Our goal is to help you understand what to expect and how to make informed decisions about your next career move with Teva. Find the Right Role Online Application Submission Screening Interviews & Assessments Offer & Onboarding Frequently Asked Questions Step 1: Find the Right Role Start by exploring open opportunities on the Teva Careers site. Search Smarter: Use filters for keyword, location, area of interest, and country to find positions that align with your expertise and career interests. Stay Connected: We recommend creating a candidate profile to make the application process easier. With a candidate profile, you can: • Upload your CV • Save jobs to review or apply to later • Apply more quickly for future opportunities • Set up job alerts to be notified when new roles match your interests Step 2: Online Application Submission Once you’ve found a match, our application process is straightforward. You will complete a short online form and upload your CV so we can learn more about your experience, skills, and interests. You will receive a confirmation email once your submission is successful. Know someone who works at Teva? Great! We highly recommend reaching out and applying through them. Important to know: You are welcome to apply to more than one role at Teva. However, we recommend only applying to positions where your skills and experience are the strongest match. Each candidate can apply only once per specific role, so be sure to review your application before submitting. Before applying, we encourage you to learn more about us: What we do at Teva | Our Research & Development pipeline | Company news | Benefits and wellbeing | Growth at Teva | Our values Your CV & Application Tips Your CV is our first opportunity to learn about your experience and impact. We recommend tailoring it to the role you’re applying for, rather than using a single version for every application. A few tips to help you put your best foot forward: Focus on relevance Review the job description and highlight experience, skills, and projects that align most closely with the role. Show your impact Where possible, share specific examples of what you worked on and the outcome. Clear, concrete details help us understand your contribution. Demonstrate how you work Collaboration, learning, and problem-solving are important at Teva. Showing how you approach challenges can be just as valuable as listing responsibilities. Keep it clear and concise Focus on what’s most meaningful for the role. Cover letters are optional unless noted in the job posting. If you choose to include one, use it to share your motivation for the role and how your experience connects to our work. Looking for more guidance? Read our article How to Stand Out in Pharma Job Applications for practical tips on strengthening your application. A note on timing Hiring timelines can vary depending on the role, location, and interview process. Our team carefully reviews each application to identify candidates whose skills and experience best match the requirements of the position. Throughout the process, we aim to keep you informed about the status of your application. Step 3: Screening Once our hiring team selects your application to move forward, you will begin with an initial screening. Recruiter Chat: This is typically a phone or live video conversation with a recruiter, where you can discuss your experience, career goals, and learn more about the role, the team, and what it’s like to work at Teva. You’ll also have the opportunity to ask questions and decide whether the role feels like the right fit. On-Demand Video: For some roles, you may instead be invited to complete a self-recorded video interview, where you respond to a few structured questions within a set timeframe. This allows our team to learn more about your background and experience before deciding w

Teva Pharmaceuticals.title: Pivot To Growth: The Teva Journey
Teva Pharmaceuticals.description: Skip To Main Content Country Pivot to Growth: The Acceleration Phase FEBRUARY 17, 2026 LEADERSHIP RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT GROWTH INNOVATION Teva’s Pivot to Growth strategy is reshaping the company’s future. As of the end of 2025, Teva has delivered 3 consecutive years of growth, supported by a robust pipeline, and a clear forward vision. At a recent strategy day presentation to industry professionals, CEO Richard Francis explains why now is the time to accelerate. Progress so far In May 2023, Teva President and CEO Richard Francis revealed the company’s Pivot to Growth strategy. Two years on, its successful execution has been clearly demonstrated: 11 consecutive quarters of growth as of Q3 2025 A strong financial performance, with 2024 revenues of $16.5 billion* for the full year reflecting a 6% overall increase Global sales of $3.9 billion for the first three months of 2025* are 5% up on the previous year’s first quarter. CEO perspective "Teva is a very different company than it was two years ago. We have sustainable growth. We have a world-class, late-stage pipeline. We have a good cash flow. We are moving from a world-class generics company to a world-class biopharma company enabled by generics." Richard Francis, Teva President and CEO Our Pivot to Growth strategy is clear Teva will continue to grow through 2027 driven by our innovative portfolio, drive a stable and cash-generating generics powerhouse and modernize the organization. We will accelerate growth beyond 2027 with our innovative pipeline. The four pillars of Pivot to Growth Pivot to Growth is not a tagline, it’s a detailed strategy built on four pillars: Deliver on growth engines and support patients with conditions including schizophrenia, migraine and involuntary movement disorders. Teva has accelerated its innovative portfolio to $2.3 billion, representing 30% core growth over the last two years. Read more: Deliver on Growth Engines Step up innovation by working on breakthrough treatments for diseases that are on the rise worldwide, such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), asthma and rheumatoid arthritis. The last two years have seen several new treatment launches and positive results for treatments in clinical trials at Teva. Read more: Step Up Innovation Sustain Teva’s position as a generics powerhouse and continue to provide affordable medicines globally. Teva’s generics business has grown by 5% across all regions since 2023. Read more: Generics Powerhouse and Access to Medicines Focus Teva’s business towards growth drivers by optimizing its portfolio and modernizing operations. Demonstrated by Teva’s transformation through its Pivot to Growth strategy. What comes next? Teva is a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by our world-class generics business to reliably deliver medicines to patients worldwide. With a robust late-stage pipeline and a sharpened focus on innovation and execution, we’ve entered the Acceleration Phase of our Pivot to Growth strategy. “The past two years have been about returning to growth and building a solid foundation. Today, Teva is a fundamentally different company, more focused, more innovative, and more robust. I am proud that we have consistently delivered on our commitments. Now, we are accelerating our growth into a leading biopharma company with a strong innovative medicines franchise and a powerhouse generics and biosimilars portfolio,” says Richard Francis. “We are scaling our growth engines, modernizing our operations, and unlocking long-term value across every part of the business. In every dimension - commercial, scientific, operational, and financial - we are executing with clarity and confidence.” Acceleration Phase priorities: Innovative portfolio: continues to drive strong performance and future potential, aiming to build a >$5 billion innovative medicines franchise by 2030 Late-stage pipeline: includes treatments for IBD, asthma, schizophrenia, multiple system atrophy (MSA) and celiac disease Biosimilars and OTC: a 13-strong biosimilars pipeline has the potential for 6 new launches by 2027, while a $1.1 billion OTC global business can achieve double-digit growth 2027 financial targets: reaffirmed targets include >$700 million in net savings and free cash flows of >$2.7 billion in 2027 and >$3.5 billion by 2030 Our strategy speaks to our Teva purpose – being all in for better health we work together to achieve remarkable things. Our direction is clear, and we are committed to keep raising the bar, in service of our patients, customers and healthcare systems. *All revenues in local currency terms NPS-ALL-NP-01710 FEBRUARY 2026 Read about the milestones on the journey Teva's Innovative Portfolio Fuels 10th Consecutive Quarter of Growth in Q2 2025 Teva Reports Ninth Consecutive Quarter of Growth in Q1 2025 Teva Delivers Second Consecutive Year of Growth 2024 Teva Announces Strong Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2024 Teva Announces Strong Growth in Second Quarter Revenues 2024 Teva Reports First Quarter 2024 Financial Results and Reaffirms 2024 Financial Outlook (tevapharm.com) Leading During Business Transformation: Richard Francis reflects on one year of Pivot to Growth at Teva Teva Reports Growth in Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 (tevapharm.com) Teva Reports Third Quarter 2023 Financial Results and Increases Revenue Guidance (tevapharm.com) Teva Reports Second Quarter 2023 Financial Results (tevapharm.com) Teva Launches New “Pivot to Growth” Strategy (tevapharm.com) Interested in getting involved in the work that we do? Vetric Technology.title: Account Manager Tel Aviv, Israel Apply
Vetric Technology.description: Vetric ALL JOBS Account Manager Sales Tel Aviv, Israel Description What is Vetric? Vetric builds large-scale public data infrastructure. We provide data pipelines that collect, structure, and deliver high-volume public web data for mission-critical companies operating in cybersecurity, public safety and digital risk protection. Our systems power platforms that detect bad actors, uncover impersonation and fraud, identify coordinated manipulation, and help public safety organizations respond faster to real-world risks. We don’t build dashboards, and we don’t sell surface-level insights. We build stable, production-grade data flows that become part of our customers’ core products, with the real impact of saving lives or huge known organizations from bad actors. Operating globally, we serve industry leaders across more than 20 countries who rely on us for scale, reliability, and depth. ﻿ Why Vetric? Vetric is profitable from day one (fully bootstrapped - we haven’t raised external funding), and we’re building foundational technology - not chasing trends. Because this is infrastructure that matters, we operate with engineering discipline, strong ownership, and long-term thinking. We’re at a true inflection point: the team is now large enough to require real infrastructure, yet still small enough that what you build will define how things work for the next several years. This is infrastructure that matters and so is how we operate internally. You’ll be working with a sharp, focused team that takes engineering discipline seriously and is intentionally building an organization that matches the quality of its product. Position Overview We’re looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with Vetric’s existing customers and become a trusted partner in their long-term success. As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for a portfolio of strategic accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding how our customers use Vetric’s data infrastructure, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships. You’ll combine strong relationship management with a commercial mindset - ensuring customers see continued value while driving retention, renewals, and account growth. This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, customer-oriented, and commercially driven, with the ability to build trust, uncover opportunities, and navigate relationships across both business and technical stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Own and manage a portfolio of existing customers, serving as their primary commercial point of contact throughout the relationship. Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, needs, and strategic priorities. Drive customer retention and renewals by proactively managing account health, identifying risks, and ensuring customers continue to see strong value from Vetric. Identify and execute expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Develop account plans and growth strategies for key customers, identifying new use cases, teams, and opportunities to expand the partnership. Lead commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and contract expansions. Work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and address customer needs. Maintain accurate account information, opportunities, forecasts, and activities in the CRM. Consistently meet or exceed retention, renewal, and expansion targets and KPIs. Requirements 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success with commercial ownership, or a similar customer-facing role within a SaaS company. Proven experience managing and growing mid-size and enterprise accounts. Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated experience in renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion. Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into meaningful business opportunities. Highly proactive and organized, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently. Experience with CRM platforms and account management tools. Fluent English, with native-level proficiency preferred. We’d be lucky if you had: Experience working with data infrastructure, APIs, cybersecurity, public safety, or digital risk protection solutions. Experience managing global enterprise customers, particularly in the US market. Experience working with technical stakeholders and complex, mission-critical products. B.A. degree in a relevant field. We hire people, not just skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this role is a great fit for you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. ALL JOBS

Because this is infrastructure that matters, it requires engineering discipline, ownership, and long-term thinking. As part of our broader R&D expansion, we’re building Kraków into a key engineering hub that will own core systems and drive our next phase of innovation and growth. ﻿The Role & The Challenge We are seeking a DevOps Engineer, at the mid or senior level, to join our infrastructure team, reporting directly to our DevOps Team Leader. Depending on experience, this role will either contribute to or help drive advanced infrastructure initiatives — from system design through production hardening — as we raise the bar for operational excellence across the company. The immediate challenge: Vetric operates a high-volume, multi-account AWS environment. You will help solve complex delivery, scaling, and operational problems along the way. Scope and ownership will be calibrated to your experience level. Responsibilities Contribute to Cloud & Migration Strategy: Work alongside our DevOps Team Leader to help plan and execute our migration from ECS Fargate to Kubernetes (EKS) without downtime, while maintaining our existing cloud estate. Advance Infrastructure as Code: Design and implement modern, modular IaC frameworks utilizing Terraform and OpenTofu to ensure consistent, multi-environment deployments. Improve Enterprise CI/CD: Evolve our delivery pipelines (GitHub Actions, OIDC federation) at scale, reducing developer friction and elevating deployment safety across dozens of services. Support Data-Intensive Infrastructure: Help maintain the performance, capacity, and resilience of our high-volume data layer (ClickHouse, ScyllaDB, DynamoDB, RDS, Redis) and event-driven messaging pipelines. Strengthen Reliability & Observability: Help maintain organization-wide reliability standards using open, modern telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry, Coralogix, Grafana), ensuring on-call operations are driven by signal, not noise. Balance Growth & Governance: Participate in technical tradeoff decisions that balance velocity, least-privilege security, zero-trust access (Tailscale), and FinOps cost efficiency. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on DevOps, Infrastructure, or Cloud Engineering experience, with real production exposure in high-throughput, data-intensive environments. Cloud Expertise: Solid working knowledge of AWS architectures, including compute, networking (VPC, DNS, segmentation), IAM, and scalability patterns. Kubernetes Experience: Hands-on experience running and/or optimizing Kubernetes clusters (EKS) in production. IaC & Automation Proficiency: Strong experience with Terraform and solid scripting/software engineering skills in Python, Go, or TypeScript, plus confident Bash. Container & Pipeline Ownership: Familiarity with container workloads (ECS/Docker) and modern CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions) using safe rollout strategies. Observability: Experience designing and/or operating observability and alerting stacks (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs). Collaborative Communication: Pragmatic, clear communicator who thrives in a high-velocity, autonomous team environment and builds trust through sound technical judgment. Note: We're hiring across mid to senior levels for this role. The depth of your experience across the above areas will determine the scope and seniority of the position offered. Beneficial Experience Direct experience leading an ECS-to-Kubernetes migration in a production environment. Deep knowledge of EKS ecosystem tooling (Karpenter, ArgoCD/Flux, KEDA, VPC CNI). Experience operating analytical or wide-column databases at scale (ClickHouse, ScyllaDB). ALL JOBS

Windward.description: ⚡ Bottom Line Up Front 01 More Bab el-Mandeb Vessels Transmit AIS After Perim Island Takeover Satellite imagery captured 0801 UTC on 14 September shows more vessels transmitting AIS while crossing Bab el-Mandeb — a shift in visibility, not a rise in transit volume — following the Houthi takeover of Perim Island, with no dark vessels detected transiting at the time. 02 Iran Updates Non-Compliance List for Hormuz Transits Iran's maritime authority has updated its standing Non-Compliance List for the Strait of Hormuz — vessels in violation of transit protocols face fines, detention, or confiscation on future passages. 03 AIS Identity Signaling Broadens Beyond Chinese Affiliation Vessels transiting near Bab el-Mandeb are broadcasting a wider mix of protective identity claims in their AIS destination field — now spanning Russian, Turkish, and religious-affiliation signaling. 04 Saudi Fleet Absorbs Multi-Million-Dollar Cape Diversion Cost Fourteen Saudi-flagged vessels have rerouted around the Cape of Good Hope since 20 July rather than transit Bab el-Mandeb, adding an estimated $13-14 million in voyage costs across the fleet. 05 Hormuz VLCCiVLCCVery Large Crude Carrier — tanker class carrying 200,000–320,000 deadweight tonnes of crude oil. eSH.description: esh ALL JOBS מנהל/ת חשבונות ראשי/ת esh Bank - Accounting and Finance Bank esh IL, Tel Aviv, Israel Full-time Description ב-esh אנחנו לא פותחים עוד בנק – אנחנו משנים את הבנקאות בישראל ומקימים בנק טכנולוגי וחדשני מאפס. זה אומר שאין אצלנו "ככה עשינו תמיד", אלא הזדמנות אמיתית ליזום, לאפיין ולעצב את תהליכי הליבה הפיננסיים של הבנק החדש בישראל. Job Description לצוות המנצח שלנו אנחנו מחפשים מנהל/ת חשבונות ראשי/ת – פונקציה מרכזית ועצמאית שתחזיק את המושכות של התשתית החשבונאית והפיננסית שלנו מקצה לקצה. אם יש לך תשוקה למספרים,נסיון מגוף פיננסי, דיוק ללא פשרות, אבל גם דרייב לשפר תהליכים, לעבוד בסביבה צומחת ולהיות חלק ממהפכה בעולם הפיננסי – המקום שלך איתנו. Responsibilities איך ה-Impact שלך ייראה ביום-יום? הנהלת חשבונות ותשלומים: אחריות מקצה לקצה על תהליכי סגירת חודש, רבעון ושנה עד מאזן. ניהול תהליך תשלומים לספקים מקומיים ובחו״ל, בקרה תקציבית ותזרים מזומנים שוטף. דיווחים למוסדות, טיפול בפחת ורכוש קבוע. שכר ובקרות פנסיוניות: ריכוז נתוני שכר, עבודה מול לשכת השכר וביצוע בקרות שוטפות. ניהול הממשק מול המתפעל הפנסיוני (מס"ב, טופסי עובדים, טיפול בחריגים והיזון חוזר). חדשנות, נהלים ורגולציה: ייזום, הטמעה ושדרוג של תהליכי עבודה ובקרות מתקדמות. יישום נהלי הבנק ושמירה על בקרות נאותות (SOX) ברמה הגבוהה ביותר של מוסד פיננסי מפוקח. Requirements מה אנחנו מחפשים? ניסיון מקצועי: 5+ שנות ניסיון כמנהל/ת חשבונות יחיד/ה או ראשי/ת – חובה. השכלה: תעודת הנהלת חשבונות סוג 3 / מדופלם/ת – חובה. רקע פיננסי: ניסיון מוקדם מבנק, גוף מוסדי או חברה פיננסית מפוקחת – יתרון משמעותי. עולם השכר: ניסיון וידע בתחומי שכר ובקרות פנסיוניות (תעודת חשב/ת שכר – יתרון משמעותי). ארגז כלים טכנולוגי: היכרות מצוינת עם חשבשבת, מערכות ERP ושליטה גבוהה ב-Excel. Mindset: יכולת עבודה עצמאית גבוהה לצד עבודת צוות, גישה של Problem Solver, סדר, דיוק, ניהול משימות מרובות ויחסי אנוש מעולים. APPLY FOR THIS JOB ALL JOBS

Job Description אנחנו מחפשים בנקאי/ת לצוות שירות הלקוחות שלנו! אם יש לכם יכולות תקשורת מצוינות ותשוקה לבנקאות דיגיטלית, ואתם רוצים לקחת חלק בהגדרה מחדש של חוויית הבנקאות בישראל, מקומכם איתנו. הבנקאים שלנו הם ערוץ התמיכה והשירות המרכזי עבור הלקוחות, ומספקים מענה איכותי, מקצועי ואמפתי דרך צ'אט וטלפון במגוון רחב של נושאים בנקאיים, טכנולוגיים ותפעוליים. Responsibilities מתן שירות מקצועי, יעיל וממוקד לקוח באמצעות צ'אט, דוא"ל וטלפון בנושאים טכנולוגיים ועסקיים. הדרכה והכוונת לקוחות בשימוש בכלים דיגיטליים באפליקציה, תוך הבטחת פתרון מלא וסגירת פנייה כבר במגע הראשון (FCR), בהתאם ליעדים. ניהול “רגעי אמת” מול לקוחות וטיפול אפקטיבי ויסודי בפתרון בעיות. Requirements ניסיון קודם במוקד שירות לקוחות. תודעת שירות גבוהה ורצון אמיתי לעזור לאחרים, כולל אמפתיה ויכולת הקשבה פעילה. כישורי תקשורת מצוינים בכתב ובעל פה, ויכולת להסביר נושאים מורכבים בצורה ברורה ופשוטה. אנגלית ברמה גבוהה - חובה. אוריינטציה טכנולוגית חזקה והבנה עמוקה של סביבות דיגיטליות. יכולת למידה מהירה וניהול ריבוי משימות (Multitasking) בסביבה דינמית. יחסי אנוש מצוינים, יכולת עבודה בצוות וגישה חיובית וסבלנית גם במצבי לחץ. זמינות לעבודה במשמרות (5 משמרות בשבוע) + ימי שישי לפי הצורך. ניסיון במתן שירות מבוסס צ'אט - יתרון ניסיון קודם בבנקאות או בשירותים פיננסיים - יתרון מה אנחנו מציעים? תנאים מעולים: קרן השתלמות החל מהיום הראשון. גמישות: מודל עבודה היברידי המשלב יומיים מהמשרד והשאר מהבית. אווירה ומיקום: עבודה בסביבה טכנולוגית מתקדמת, צעירה ודינמית. המשרדים שלנו ממוקמים בתל אביב, סמוך לתחנת רכבת ההגנה (הגעה נוחה וקלה!). There is no "that’s how it’s always been done" here. Instead, you'll have a genuine opportunity to innovate, take ownership, and shape key processes and products at Israel’s newest bank. Job Description We are looking for a highly skilled, technical, and multidisciplinary Deputy CISO to join our Bank's Information Security team. Reporting directly to the CISO, this key position serves as a right-hand lead in shaping technological strategy, managing risk, and implementing security policy. The role operates as a Senior Individual Contributor (IC) requiring high independence and real-world hands-on capabilities, and a strong 'all hands on deck' mindset. Responsibilities Strategic & Tech Partnership: Collaborate with the CISO and CIO to design security architecture, implement advanced solutions, and lead end-to-end tech projects. Cloud Security & DevSecOps: Guide development teams, define secure cloud architectures, and enforce SSDF. Hands-on Execution: Evaluate and deploy security technologies, analyze cyber/infrastructure incidents, and write/review code and scripts. GRC & Banking Compliance: Lead GRC end-to-end, manage external pen-testing vendors, handle third-party/supply chain risk, ensure compliance with Bank of Israel regulations, and support audits. Requirements 5–10 years of experience in InfoSec and technology as a senior independent function. Strong cloud security expertise (AWS preferred; Azure/GCP accepted). Hands-on development background or deep technical understanding of CI/CD, containers, Microservices, and API Security. Hands-on proficiency at the code, network, and infrastructure levels. Excellent interpersonal skills and broad business vision, and strong collaborative abilities. Advantages Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, or AWS/Cloud Security certifications. Experience with financial platforms or core banking systems. Real-time Incident Response (IR) experience. Deep acquaintance with banking GRC and Bank of Israel guidelines.
